Definition: Each project includes a short vertical summary: one field name per row, with counts, links to the paper and data repository, and how the study was measured (instrument, TMT chemistry, database used for protein identification). Cohort numbers count TMT channels (quantitative profiles), not only unique patients.
Source: Compiled for the Atlas from the study registry and from the sample table for that project.

Definition: Canonical Atlas identifier and GitHub folder name (PDC…, PXD…, IPX…, MSV…, including split packs such as _epithelium). Use it to locate CSV/XLSX files and the project README.
Source: Name of the project folder on the Atlas site.

Definition: Public data repository hosting the mass spectrometry files (PDC, PRIDE, MassIVE, IProX, …). It describes where raw data live, not the disease label of the specimens.
Source: Study registry.

Definition: PubMed ID of the primary publication that describes the cohort and methods. Atlas harmonization follows this paper and the repository metadata, not secondary reviews.
Source: Publication record.

Definition: HTTPS link to the PubMed record built from PMID. Provided for convenience in summary; the PMID alone is the stable identifier.
Source: Generated from the PubMed ID.

Definition: Landing page for the dataset at the repository (download, sample table, sometimes clinical export). Differs from PubMed URL, which points to the article.
Source: Data repository web page.

Definition: Count of result rows with a non-empty Ensembl protein column when that optional column is present in the pack. Zero or absent column means the source matrix had no ENSP identifiers to carry over.
Source: Counted from the protein table.

Definition: Count of rows where Protein IDs contains a valid UniProt accession after Atlas mapping. This is the usual headline protein count for the study; it can be lower than raw author rows if mapping failed.
Source: Counted from the protein table.

Definition: Total lines in the result table. Atlas keeps every author row separately even when the same accession appears more than once.
Source: Counted from the protein table.

Definition: Distinct Case submitter IDs with proteomic profiles in patients/samples or annotation. Cell-line-only or pool-only designs may show 0; pools do not inflate this count unless donors are documented.
Source: Distinct patient IDs in the clinical tables.

Definition: Patients counted with harmonized gender Male in the clinical table. Single-letter M from the source is converted to Male; Not Reported patients are excluded from this tally.
Source: Clinical table.

Definition: Patients counted with harmonized gender Female. Single-letter F from the source is converted to Female.
Source: Clinical table.

Definition: Patients whose gender is Not Reported after harmonization. Distinct from Male/Female counts; the three categories should not double-count individuals.
Source: Clinical table.

Definition: Optional summary breakdown of sex within the disease cohort when curators recorded it. Not present in every pack; interpret together with Male/Female patients fields.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Patient count for the disease arm using Atlas summary rules for that project. May differ from channel counts when one patient contributes tumor and normal profiles.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Donors contributing normal or control proteomes under Atlas donor accounting. Related to but not identical to Control Healthy, which counts channels.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Number of TMT profiles classified as precancerous when the study design includes such material. Zero in most packs; when non-zero, read Sample type and disease fields on those channels.
Source: Sample table or study registry.

Definition: TMT profiles counted as untreated tumor channels in Atlas summary buckets. Based on channel/sample metadata, not on whether the patient never received any therapy in life.
Source: Sample table (channel classification for the map).

Definition: TMT profiles counted as treated or recurrent tumor channels. Includes post-therapy specimens when metadata or registry mapping assigns them here.
Source: Sample table (channel classification for the map).

Definition: TMT profiles counted in the control/normal summary bucket for the organ map. This is a channel tally for Atlas UI categories, not a claim that every labeled channel is histologically normal or from a healthy donor.
Source: Sample table (channel classification for the map).

Definition: Rare bucket for treated control profiles when registry or channel notes require it. Most studies show 0.
Source: Study registry.

Definition: Number of quantitative TMT profiles in the harmonized matrix: equals annotation rows and abundance columns in result (excluding ID columns). Includes pools and reference channels when they occupy a reporter slot counted in the design.
Source: Sample table (row count).

Definition: Profiles where Sample type is Cell Line (or harmonized equivalent). Patient counts are often 0 even when many channels are present.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Profiles from intact tissue biospecimens rather than cultured lines. Derived from Sample type and biospecimen mapping in annotation.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Channels labeled as pools or mixed references in annotation. Pool channels may aggregate multiple donors; see pool reference fields and curator notes.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: How many distinct pool reference designs appear (e.g. one bridge pool per plex). Design-level count, not number of pool channels.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Primary label or ID for the main pooled reference used in ratios. May appear in annotation Note or ratio denominator fields.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Documentation of which donors are inside a pool when the publication or curator recorded it. Often Not Reported when the pool is anonymous.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Organ or system context for the study (Ovary, Lung, Colon, …). Taken from curator registry and design; may differ from Primary site on individual channels in multi-organ studies.
Source: Study registry.

Definition: Short disease label for the cohort (e.g. HGSOC, CRC). Describes the study context; individual channels can still carry finer Disease type text.
Source: Study registry and publication.

Definition: Dominant material class in the study (Tissue, Cell Line, mixed). Summarizes the pack; per-channel Sample type can vary (e.g. tumor + adjacent normal).
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Full publication title as recorded in the registry. Use PMID/DOI for citation; title may be truncated on the organ-map card.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.
Example: Proteogenomic Characterization of Ovarian HGSC Implicates Mitotic Kinases, Replication Stress in …

Definition: Mass spectrometer platform used for LC-MS/MS (unified curator label). Does not include search engine or quant software unless noted elsewhere in README.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: TMT multiplex chemistry (10-plex, 11-plex, TMTpro 16-plex, …). Should be consistent with Experiment type on annotation rows for the same study.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Study-wide description of how abundances were normalized or expressed (summary field). Not the same as per-column Metric type in annotation, which describes each result column (often Log Ratio).
Source: Study registry and methods description.
Example: Universal pooled reference normalization; CDAP harmonization; log2 relative abundance ratios

Definition: Narrative of the experimental design (paired tumor/normal, time course, cell-line panel, …). Complements channel-level ratio numerator/denominator fields.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.
Example: TMT10; proteome + phosphoproteome; LC-MS/MS; WXS; RNA-seq

Definition: Curator short abstract of cohort size, material, and intent. May overlap with Short Description on the organ-map catalog row.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.
Example: Proteogenomic characterization of 83 prospectively collected ovarian HGSC and 20 normal FT sample…

Definition: What a single numeric cell in result represents (protein abundance, log ratio, iBAQ, …). Read together with Metric type on annotation columns.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Calendar year of the protein sequence database used for identification (FASTA). Affects which isoforms were searchable; not the publication year.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.

Definition: Fixed and variable modifications allowed in the database search (TMT on lysine/N-term, carbamidomethyl, oxidation, …). Copied from registry/methods text; not a list of every modification observed on a specific peptide.
Source: Study registry and project summary for this dataset.
Example: Fixed: Carbamidomethyl(C); TMT10plex(K); TMT10plex(N-term) Variable: Oxidation(M)

Definition: Target false discovery rate (%) for identifications reported by the authors or portal. Atlas does not re-filter the author matrix to a new FDR in the harmonized files.
Source: Study registry (search settings).

Definition: Project-specific summary keys (DOI, Atlas caveats, compartment, …).
Source: Pack build or QC; listed in project README.

Definition: The sample table lists one row per TMT channel—each row matches exactly one numeric column in the protein matrix. Clinical information is repeated on every channel from the same patient. To link a channel to abundances, use Column name: it must match the protein-table header character for character.
Source: Sample and clinical metadata from the publication and public repository (PDC, PRIDE, MassIVE, IProX, etc.).

Definition: Exact header of the matching quantitative column in result. Primary join key between annotation and result; must match character for character.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Quantity represented in the linked result column (typically Log Ratio to a reference). Not patient age and not the TMT channel index.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Physical TMT reporter slot (126, 127N, 131…). Instrument design label, not a clinical variable.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Plex or sub-run name from the author files (e.g. 10-plex A).
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Ordinal index of the plex within the study design.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: LC-MS fractions combined for the channel, if reported; otherwise Not Reported.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: TMT chemistry on the channel (TMT10, TMT 11-plex, TMTpro 16-plex). Should align with summary TMT type.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Measured layer (usually Proteome; phosphoproteome and other layers may be separate files or studies).
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Repository ID of the analyzed aliquot.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Specimen or role in the ratio numerator (tumor aliquot, bridge channel, …).
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Reference channel, pool, or bridge in the denominator—defines direction of Log Ratio.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Repository biospecimen ID; one patient may have several sample IDs.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.
Example: Same as aliquot or parent sample ID

Definition: Harmonized specimen class (Primary Tumor, Solid Tissue Normal, Cell Line, Reference, Pool…). See Sample type values sheet.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Patient or donor ID; use for counting people, not channels.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Diagnosis or disease context for this channel from clinical metadata.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Primary disease site or organ for the channel.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Anatomic site where the specimen was taken.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Tissue category from clinical metadata (Tumor, Normal, …) as provided by the source.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Tumor status descriptor (Primary, Metastatic, Treatment-naive, …).
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Histologic grade when available; Not Reported if absent.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Disease stage when available; Not Applicable for lines or blood-only channels.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Morphology or histology string from the source.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Additional tumor or clone classification from metadata.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Alive, Dead, or Not Reported at last follow-up.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Male, Female, or Not Reported in harmonized packs (not single-letter M/F).
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Ethnicity when reported; often Not Reported.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Race when reported in the source.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Age in years at diagnosis for the case linked to the channel.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.

Definition: Free-text curator or author notes: pool composition, QC, excluded channels, literature cross-reference.
Source: Repository or publication metadata for this channel.
Example: Plex reference channel; verification against PDC portal

Definition: Paper-specific columns — see headers in your pack.
Source: Outside the standard 29 columns; see project README.

Definition: The protein table lists one row per reported protein line from the authors. Identifier columns on the left are followed by abundance or ratio values, one column per channel. RefSeq and Ensembl protein columns appear only in studies where the original data included those identifiers.
Source: Quantitative matrix from the publication; protein and gene names supplemented from UniProt and HGNC where possible.

Definition: Gene symbol from the author table. Atlas may adjust spelling via HGNC when a clear mapping exists; the symbol is not the protein accession.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: HGNC symbol after Atlas annotation.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: Gene name from UniProt (not the accession in Protein IDs).
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: Primary UniProt accession for the row (one accession, no semicolon lists). May come from direct author IDs or mapping from RefSeq/Ensembl tokens in the source.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: Ensembl protein identifier (ENSP…) when present in the source matrix. Column omitted entirely in packs where every value was empty.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: RefSeq protein accession from the source, including version suffix when authors provided it. Optional column; omitted when empty across the pack.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: Ensembl gene ID (ENSG…) when carried from the author file or mapping pipeline.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: HGNC locus group for the annotated gene (e.g. protein-coding gene). Added during Atlas annotation, not from the mass spectrometer.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: HGNC locus type (e.g. gene with protein product). Describes the gene record, not the peptide evidence.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: Full protein descriptive name from UniProt/HGNC lookup. Longer than the gene symbol; useful for reporting.
Source: Publication protein table; names from UniProt/HGNC where annotated.

Definition: Intensity or log ratio for one TMT profile (one TMT channel). Each column after the ID block is one row in annotation; values are author-reported abundances or ratios, not re-normalized by Atlas unless stated in README.
Source: Copied from the author matrix; header text must equal Column name in annotation.

Definition: When present, this table holds one row per patient or biospecimen (not per TMT channel). The same person may appear once here but on several rows in the sample table if tumor and normal were measured separately.
Source: Clinical data supplied by the repository; some cell-line studies omit this table.

Definition: Age in years (synonym of Age at diagnosis).
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: Days from diagnosis to death.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: Recorded cause of death.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: Primary diagnosis.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: Tissue or organ of origin.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: Resection or biopsy site.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: AJCC pathologic stage.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: AJCC T category.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: AJCC N category.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: AJCC M category.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: Year of diagnosis.
Source: Repository clinical export.

Definition: Same semantics as the homonymous annotation columns.
Source: One row per patient; annotation is per channel.

Definition: Excel bundle for readers who open result_<ID>.xlsx first; sheets duplicate the CSV tables described elsewhere in this dictionary.
Source: Standard pack layout on GitHub (120 projects).

Definition: Each project ships the same tables as CSV files and as one Excel workbook (result_<ID>.xlsx). Sheets mirror the CSV set; column titles match the Annotation and Result dictionary sheets. For study-level counts and methods, prefer the vertical <ID>_summary.csv (field name in column A, value in column B).
Source: Pack layout for GitHub releases.

Definition: Wide one-row (or two-row) passport inside the workbook. Same study metadata as <ID>_summary.csv but laid out horizontally; some cells may be empty while the CSV summary is complete. Use the CSV summary as the primary reference for cohort counts.
Source: Written when the workbook is built from the harmonized pack.
Example: Project ID; UniProt proteins; TMT type

Definition: One row per TMT channel (= one quantitative column in Result). Definitions for every column are on the Annotation sheet of this dictionary; link to abundances via Column name.
Source: Same rows as <ID>_annotation.csv.
Example: Column name; Sample type; Case submitter ID

Definition: Protein matrix: fixed identifier columns on the left, then one floating-point column per channel. Each quantitative header equals the Column name of the matching annotation row.
Source: Same data as <ID>_result.csv.

Definition: Patient- or specimen-level clinical table when the study provides one. Same semantics as <ID>_patients.csv or <ID>_samples.csv; not every project includes this sheet or a separate CSV.
Source: Repository clinical export, one row per case or biospecimen.
Example: Case submitter ID; Age at diagnosis

Definition: Every column after the identifier block is one TMT profile. Values are abundances or log ratios (see Metric type on the channel). Suffix patterns (Log Ratio, Unshared Log Ratio, …) are indexed on the Result_vocabulary tab.
Source: Author matrix; headers preserved from the harmonized export.

Definition: A few legacy or author-specific headers (statistics, IPA annotations, extra accession columns) are not part of the ten-column Atlas ID canon. They are listed in Atlas_result_vocabulary.csv and the Result_vocabulary Excel tab with pack counts.
Source: Scanned across 120 packs; rare outside the source publication.

Column header: CSV files in the project folder
Definition: <ID>_summary.csv, <ID>_annotation.csv, <ID>_result.csv, and optionally <ID>_patients.csv or <ID>_samples.csv — preferred for scripting and diffing; the workbook is provided for convenience.
Source: GitHub project folder alongside result_<ID>.xlsx.

Definition: The organ-map browser and downloadable project list contain one row per study (120 projects). Figures and text are meant for overview and comparison across organs; full protein data remain in each project folder.
Source: Curated study descriptions; numbers are aligned with each project’s summary file when both are complete.

Definition: Public repository hosting raw mass-spectrometry files (PDC, PRIDE, MassIVE, IProX). Describes where data are stored, not the diagnosis of specimens. Same field as Repository in <ID>_summary.csv.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Canonical Atlas study identifier and GitHub folder name (PDC…, PXD…, IPX…, MSV…, including split packs such as _epithelium). Use it to locate CSV, XLSX, and README in the project directory.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: PubMed ID of the primary publication that defines cohort and methods. Harmonization follows this paper and repository metadata, not secondary reviews.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Full publication title from the registry. For citation use PMID/DOI; the organ-map card may truncate long titles.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.
Example: Proteogenomic Characterization of Ovarian HGSC Implicates Mitotic Kinases, Replication Stress in …

Definition: Number of quantitative TMT profiles (channels) in the released matrix—equal to Total biological samples in summary and usually equal to Samples Used N. Cohort bucket fields count the same channels; their sum should match this number.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: TMT profiles classified as precancerous when the study includes such material. Zero in most projects; if non-zero, inspect Sample type and disease fields on those channels. Same meaning as PreCancer in summary.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Tumor profiles (channels) classified as untreated in Atlas summary buckets. Based on channel/sample metadata, not whether the patient never received any therapy in life.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Tumor profiles classified as treated or recurrent, including post-therapy specimens when metadata assign them here.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Profiles in the control/normal bucket for the organ map. This is a display category counting channels, not a histologic diagnosis of every labeled specimen.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Rare bucket for treated control profiles when registry or channel notes require it. Almost always 0. Same field as Healthy treated in summary.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Unique patients or donors with proteomics in the study (= Total unique patients in summary). Counts people, not channels, so it may differ from Total Samples.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Male patients with proteomics (= Male patients in summary).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Female patients with proteomics (= Female patients in summary).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Patients with sex not reported (= Sex unknown in summary).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Free-text tissue or cell-type description shown on the organ-map card.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Dominant material class for the study (= Biospecimen type in summary): Tissue, Cell Line, Primary cells, or mixed. Per-channel Sample type in annotation may include both tumor and normal.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Tissue detail for the card; may list several sites.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Organ or system in study context (Ovary, Lung, Colon…). From the curator registry; may differ from per-channel Primary site in multi-organ designs.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Tumor class for the card (free text).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Established cell line name when the study is line-based; NA or empty when tissue-only.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Cancer versus normal flags for cell-line panels; NA when not a line study.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Organ context for the cell line; NA when not applicable.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Tumor type attributed to the line; NA when not applicable.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Tissue context for the line; NA when not applicable.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Short disease label for the cohort (HGSOC, CRC…). Study-level context; per-channel Disease type may be more specific.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Finer disease subtype when recorded (e.g. high-grade serous carcinoma).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Design narrative (= Study design in summary): paired tumor/normal, proteome layers, companion assays.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.
Example: TMT10; proteome + phosphoproteome; LC-MS/MS; WXS; RNA-seq

Definition: Curator abstract: cohort size, material, and aim (= Study description in summary).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.
Example: Proteogenomic characterization of 83 prospectively collected ovarian HGSC and 20 normal FT sample…

Definition: Unified mass-spectrometer label (= Instrument in summary). Search engine and quant software are not included here.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Unified TMT chemistry label (= TMT type in summary): e.g. TMT 10-plex, TMT 11-plex, TMTpro 16-plex. Should agree with Experiment type on annotation rows for a homogeneous study.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Headline protein count (= UniProt proteins in summary): rows in result with a valid UniProt accession after Atlas mapping.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Summary of which TMT reporter slots are occupied in the design (text field, not a channel table).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: How channels were compared (e.g. tumor versus normal within a plex, bridge to pool).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Reference or bridge channels that are not cohort specimens (pools, empty slots noted in design).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Channels or specimens recorded before quality-control exclusions. May exceed Total Samples when profiles were dropped from the matrix.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Profiles retained in the final matrix; usually equals Total Samples / Total biological samples.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Study-wide normalization or ratio definition (= Metric type in summary). Not the same as per-column Metric type in annotation (often Log Ratio for one result column).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.
Example: Universal pooled reference normalization; CDAP harmonization; log2 relative abundance ratios

Definition: Level at which z-score normalization was applied, if used (protein, sample, …).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Scope of z-score normalization (global matrix, within-group, …) when applicable.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Protein sequence database used for identification (UniProt, RefSeq, …).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Reference proteome year (= Reference proteome year in summary); not the publication year.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Fixed and variable modifications in the database search. Search settings, not a list of every modification observed in data.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.
Example: Fixed: Carbamidomethyl(C); TMT 10-plex(K); TMT 10-plex(N-term) Variable: Oxidation(M)

Definition: Target false-discovery threshold in percent (= FDR threshold in summary). The value is a percent: 1 means 1%, not 0.01.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Workbook file name in the project folder: result_<Project ID>.xlsx.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Dataset page in the repository (= Project URL in summary). Not the PubMed article link.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.

Definition: Headline scientific finding for the organ-map card (free text).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.
Example: Integrated TMT10 proteogenomic and phosphoproteomic profiling of HGSC identified increased CDK/AU…

Definition: Data limitations or warnings for the study (= Limitations on some exports).
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.
Example: Relative TMT quantification dependent on pooled reference channel normalization; potential batch …

Definition: What a numeric cell in the protein matrix represents (= Quantification unit in summary): e.g. protein-level log2 ratios to a reference.
Source: Organ-map project list; compare with the project summary file.
Example: TMT reporter-ion relative quantification; protein-level log2 ratios

Definition: Look up exact spellings you see in the tables—especially Not Reported, Log Ratio, and the cohort count labels. Entries are sorted alphabetically after two general notes at the top.
Source: Shared vocabulary across all studies in the Atlas.

Definition: Files you download use everyday column titles (Project ID, Sample type). Other documentation may use underscore forms for the same fields; they are not extra columns in the files.
Source: Naming convention in technical documentation only.

Definition: Each channel’s Column name is the header of the matching abundance column in the protein table.
Source: Required for merging sample metadata with quantitative data.

Definition: Patient was alive at last follow-up, as recorded in the clinical data.
Source: Clinical metadata.

Definition: Row describes a real specimen channel, not a technical placeholder row.
Source: Repository channel list.

Definition: Number of tumor channels classified as treated or recurrent in the overview counts.
Source: Summary and organ-map counts.

Definition: Number of tumor channels classified as untreated in the overview counts.
Source: Summary and organ-map counts.

Definition: Number of channels counted as normal or control for the organ-map overview. This is a display category, not a pathological diagnosis of every labeled specimen.
Source: Summary and organ-map counts.

Definition: Patient was deceased at follow-up, as recorded in the clinical data.
Source: Clinical metadata.

Definition: Female patient or donor. Single-letter codes from source data are written out as Female.
Source: Clinical metadata.

Definition: Treated control profiles, when recorded (uncommon).
Source: Study registry.

Definition: Abundance expressed on a log scale relative to a reference channel (often log₂).
Source: Authors’ quantitative table; named in Metric type.

Definition: Male patient or donor. Single-letter codes from source data are written out as Male.
Source: Clinical metadata.

Definition: On the organ-map project card, NA means an optional field was left empty. In sample and clinical tables, missing text is normally Not Reported, not NA. A few optional summary lines may show NA when nothing was listed (for example pool donors).
Source: Organ-map card display, or optional summary text—not the clinical missing-value label.

Definition: Negative answer where the source uses Yes/No fields.
Source: Clinical or sample metadata.

Definition: Non-tumor or normal tissue context as stated in the original metadata.
Source: Clinical or tissue description fields.

Definition: The question does not apply—for example, tumor stage for a cell line or a reference channel.
Source: Assigned when the field has no meaning for that specimen type.

Definition: The study did not provide this information. The cell shows this label instead of being left blank.
Source: Repository or publication tables; missing entries are shown consistently across the Atlas.

Definition: Mixed sample or multi-donor material measured as one channel.
Source: Sample type Pool.

Definition: Precancerous profiles in the study, when this category applies.
Source: Summary or study registry.

Definition: Primary tumor, when clinical metadata uses this descriptor.
Source: Tumor descriptor field.

Definition: Whole-protein (global) measurement for that channel, as opposed to a phosphoproteome-only layer.
Source: Sample table, Analyte field.

Definition: Sample or channel that failed quality control but remained in the authors’ released data.
Source: Sample type QC Failed.

Definition: Reference TMT channel used for ratio denominators or bridging between runs—not a patient sample in the cohort.
Source: Sample type Reference; see Sample type sheet.

Definition: Ten-plex TMT labeling for this channel.
Source: Experimental design description.

Definition: Eleven-plex TMT labeling for this channel.
Source: Experimental design description.

Definition: TMTpro sixteen-plex chemistry for this channel or study.
